reviews.question: Paraphrase ba lần cho mỗi câu, dùng đa dạng cấu trúc và từ vựng nhưng giữ nguyên hoàn toàn ý nghĩa gốc.
reviews.originalEssay:
1.
- It is widely believed that wealth plays a key role in reaching true happiness.
-A large number of individuals think that money is a crucial element for a happy life.
-Financial success is considered by many to be one of the main factors necessary to achieve happiness.
2.
- While some argue that expanding sports facilities is the finest method to boost community health, others feel that it would not be very effective.
 -Certain individuals believe the most effective way to enhance public health is to build more sports centers, whereas others think this action would bring minimal results.
- It is argued by some that public health can be best improved by providing more sports amenities, but others believe this would make very little difference.
reviews.overall: Em đã làm đủ ba cách viết cho mỗi câu và ba câu của phần hai giữ được hai quan điểm. Tuy nhiên, cả ba câu của phần một đều làm lệch ý gốc: tiền phải là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất để đạt hạnh phúc. Cô yêu cầu em sửa ba câu này, giữ rõ mức độ một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất, rồi kiểm tra lại nghĩa trước khi đổi từ. Phần hai có cách đổi cấu trúc khá đa dạng và đúng ý.

annotations.label: ann-1
annotations.title: Chưa giữ mức độ quan trọng
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
A key role chỉ nói một vai trò quan trọng, chưa nêu rõ tiền là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất.

It is widely believed that money is among the most important factors in achieving happiness.

anchors.quote: It is widely believed that wealth plays a key role in reaching true happiness.

annotations.label: ann-2
annotations.title: Ý đạt hạnh phúc đã bị đổi
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
A crucial element for a happy life không giữ rõ ý một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất để đạt hạnh phúc.

A large number of individuals consider money to be one of the key elements in the pursuit of happiness.

anchors.quote: A large number of individuals think that money is a crucial element for a happy life.

annotations.label: ann-3
annotations.title: Từ thay thế làm lệch nghĩa
annotations.bodyMarkdown:
Financial success không đồng nghĩa hoàn toàn với money, còn necessary khiến tiền gần như là điều kiện bắt buộc.

It is believed by many people that financial resources constitute one of the most significant factors in achieving happiness.

anchors.quote: Financial success is considered by many to be one of the main factors necessary to achieve happiness.

2. A large number of individuals consider money to be one of the key elements in the pursuit of happiness.
3. It is believed by many people that financial resources constitute one of the most significant factors in achieving happiness.

Câu B
1. While some people argue that expanding the number of sports facilities is the best way to improve public health, others believe that this would have only a limited effect.
2. It is believed by some that public health can be improved most effectively by building more sports centres, whereas others think that this measure would bring little benefit.
3. Some individuals consider the provision of additional sports amenities to be the best means of enhancing public health; however, others believe that it would make very little difference.

reviews.question: Viết thành chuỗi hoàn chỉnh: professional sporting events (World Cup/Olympics) → facilitate tourism and related commercial activities → employment opportunities for local people.
reviews.originalEssay: Professional sports events like the World Cup or the Olympics can facilitate tourism and related commercial activities, which creates many employment opportunities for the locals.
reviews.overall: Em đã viết đủ chuỗi ý theo đúng chiều: sự kiện thể thao thúc đẩy du lịch và hoạt động thương mại, rồi tạo việc làm cho người địa phương. Tuy nhiên, phần giữa còn quá sát cụm từ của đề nên em cần paraphrase thật sự. Em cũng cần sửa động từ sau which vì cụm từ đứng trước là số nhiều. Hãy viết lại một câu theo bản gợi ý và tự soát lại hòa hợp giữa chủ ngữ với động từ.

reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
In the modern world, advertising has become an essential part of daily life. In my opinion, the continuous development of this industry is a trend that brings both positive and negative effects on individuals and society.
On the one hand, the growth of advertising brings significant benefits to both individual consumers and the economy. From consumers’ perspective, commercials bring a truly convenient and helpful buying experience. Unlike decades ago when people largely relied on local brands, nowadays, TV advertisements, pop-ups on social networking platforms, and street billboards expose people to a wide range of goods available on the market. Therefore, this helps them make wiser purchasing choices and decisions. On a far wider societal scale, advertising is a powerful driver of economic growth. Because advertisements often have engaging content and appealing visual effects, customers’ demand and purchasing power are strongly stimulated. This leads to an increase in production, which creates more employment opportunities and pours more revenue into the state budget.
On the other hand, the expansion of advertising also causes several negative consequences. Firstly, advertising often encourages wasteful spending among consumers. Persuasive advertisements can lure or entice people into buying things they may not otherwise need. This tendency is further reinforced by the endorsement of celebrities who hold strong social influence, making the promoted products more trustworthy and desirable. As a result, consumers, regardless of whether they are their fans, easily develop impulsive and wasteful buying habits. Secondly, the colossal number of advertisements has become a major source of annoyance. Audiences frequently feel overwhelmed by these commercials. For example, social network users have showcased their frustration about being constantly bombarded with pop-ups of all types. This acutely disrupts their online experience, such as gaming or watching films, because they simply fail to turn them off until half a minute later.
In conclusion, the rise of the advertising industry is a development that has both pros and cons. While it plays a beneficial role in aiding consumers and boosting the economy, it also leads to financial waste and daily annoyance for the public.
reviews.overall: Em viết đủ bài, giữ đúng hướng cân bằng và phát triển trọn vẹn hai lợi ích cùng hai tác hại đã chọn. Các chuỗi từ quảng cáo đến quyết định mua sắm, sản xuất, việc làm và ngân sách nhà nước rất rõ. Em chỉ cần gọn hơn ở “choices and decisions” vì hai từ trùng nghĩa, đồng thời nói rõ pop-ups làm gián đoạn trải nghiệm khi người dùng đang chơi game hoặc xem phim.
